# Contributing to 3ware

Thank you for your interest in contributing to 3ware repositories. These guidelines apply to every 3ware repository that does not define its own.

## Raising an Issue

- Search existing issues first to avoid duplicates.
- Describe what you expected to happen, what actually happened and how to reproduce it.
- Include relevant versions, logs or error messages.

## Submitting a Pull Request

1. Create a branch from `main` and keep the change focused on a single purpose.
2. Use a [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) style PR title, for example `fix(scope): Correct lint configuration`. PR titles are validated and used to generate release notes.
3. Complete the pull request template, explaining what has changed and why.
4. Make sure all status checks pass. Repositories use [Trunk](https://trunk.io/) for linting, which can be run locally before pushing.
5. Changes must be approved by a code owner before merging.

## Reporting a Security Vulnerability

Do not raise security issues publicly. Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead.

## Questions

Visit [www.3ware.co.uk](https://www.3ware.co.uk/) to get in touch.
